feeds.title: Illustration Age
feeds.description: Since 2009 IA has provided inspiration, education, and resources to the illustration community in the form of interviews, feature articles, link directories, and more. We also have a reputation for fighting for the rights of artists here on our website and on social media by amplifying voices calling for change, speaking out against bad behavior in the industry, and generally promoting all that is good and positive in illustration.

feeds.title: The Association of Illustrators
feeds.description: The Association of Illustrators (AOI) is a not-for-profit trade organisation, promoting contemporary illustration and maintaining industry standards, with a membership that includes freelancers, agents, students and colleges. The AOI was established in 1973 to advance and protect illustrator's rights and encourage professional standards.

feeds.title: Directory of Illustration
feeds.description: Directory of Illustration is the 'Go-To' Resource for the Creative Community. We are the leading Web Print marketing program for illustrators. The most active creatives find great artists for commercial assignments by searching & referencing the Directory of Illustration.

feeds.title: ILLUSTRATION ART
feeds.description: Celebrating great art in humble places, the glorious talents of the artists who illustrate stories, advertisements and comics.

feeds.title: Juxtapoz Magazine » Illustration
feeds.description: Founded in 1994, Juxtapoz is a monthly magazine that documents and makes accessible the creative life. This is a online version of the leading monthly contemporary and underground art bible, Juxtapoz Art and Culture Magazine, with featured articles, blogs, video, reader art, gallery guides, forums, and archives.

feeds.title: Morgan Gaynin Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Morgan Gaynin Inc. is a premier illustration agency in New York City, representing select international and award-winning artists.

feeds.title: MICA ILLUSTRATION
feeds.description: Mica illustration student news, competitions, and departmental updates from MICA.

feeds.title: Brown Paper Bag
feeds.description: Sara Barnes, an illustration blogger who enjoys ceramics & embroidery. This is a daily blog that loves illustration in its many forms (ceramics, embroidery, and tattoos ).

feeds.title: Nate Williams Blog
feeds.description: Nate Williams create Illustrations & Hand Lettering for books, magazines, packaging, advertising, products and more.

feeds.title: Arena illustration
feeds.description: Arena illustration represents a diverse group of illustrators with an array of distinctive styles. Beautiful and eye-catching illustrations for book covers, children's books, magazines and newspapers, designs for packaging and advertising campaigns.

feeds.title: Emma Block Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Emma Block is a multidisciplinary illustrator living in London, working across editorial illustration, publishing, packaging and branding. Emma's work is inspired by the people she meets in her everyday life, old photos, vintage clothes, old films, travel, 1950s illustration, 1930s jazz and sausage dogs.

feeds.title: i2i Art Inc. Blog
feeds.description: i2i Art Inc. is a leading illustration agency representing an international group of award-winning illustrators. They are a boutique agency representing a contemporary spectrum of illustration: from photo-collage, to graphic, to whimsical and every style in-between.

feeds.title: Penelope Dullaghan Blog
feeds.description: Penelope Dullaghan is a freelance illustrator, pattern maker and creative explorer. Her playful, hand-crafted style tells stories rich with color, shape and texture, aiming to inspire curiosity and good cheer for all.

feeds.title: Fabulous Doodles
feeds.description: Brooke Hagel is a New York City based fashion illustrator. While studying fashion design at the Fashion Institute of Technology. Her versatility can also be seen in the seventeen books she has illustrated and three she has contributed to.

feeds.title: Virginia Romo Illustration Blog
feeds.description: This is the blog where Virginia Romo posts her latest illustrations, projects and impressions. Her My work ranges from elegant fashion silhouettes to joyful decoration patterns. I use pencil, ink and watercolours when working at my drawing table and programs like Photoshop, Illustrator or Manga Studio when I work on my Cintiq.

feeds.title: Lemonade Illustration Agency
feeds.description: Lemonade is a multi-disciplined, Worldwide Illustration Agency serving clients in many countries and timezones. Our team is passionate about illustration and supplying images that propel your product, print, motion or viral media to a higher plain. We are privileged to represent some of the leading Illustrators, CGi Artists, Animators and Storyboard Artists working in the industry today.

feeds.title: Jan Dolby
feeds.description: Jan is a freelance illustrator. She creates her illustrations using acrylic paint, watercolour, graphite or marker mixed with the addition of Photoshop and Illustrator. The whimsicalness in her drawings and her use of bright colour stems from her love of animation and children's literature.

feeds.title: Carefree Artist
feeds.description: The art blog of award-winning artist and illustrator Mark A. Hicks. Featuring children's book, magazine, and greeting card illustration, cartoons and lots of other stuff.

feeds.title: Chloé Fleury
feeds.description: I'm Chloé Fleury. I am a french illustrator and prop stylist based in San Francisco, California. I like to transform flat sheets of paper into three-dimensional objects, and eventually bringing them to life through stop motion animation. I incorporate my paper skills into a range of advertising, editorial and window display work.

feeds.title: Andy Smith Illustrator Blog
feeds.description: Born and raised amongst the muddy fields of Norfolk, Andy Smith studied illustration at the University of Brighton and the Royal College of Art, London. Graduating in 1998 he established a client list of advertising, publishing and editorial clients

feeds.title: Alice Potter Blog
feeds.description: Alice Potter is a freelance surface pattern designer & illustrator based in London. She makes bold surface patterns, illustrations and childrenswear print design.

feeds.title: Anna Raff Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on Anna Raff, new book releases and more! Anna Raff is an award-winning illustrator living in New York City, who has illustrated several books for children. Before her career as an illustrator, Anna was a designer at The Metropolitan Museum of Art and several children's book publishers in New York City.

feeds.title: Good Illustration
feeds.description: Good Illustration is an International Illustration Agency.

feeds.title: Lisa Maltby: Illustrator, Typographer & Lettering Artist Blog
feeds.description: Lisa Maltby is an illustrator, graphic designer, typographer, lettering artist and art director. This blog is where Lisa post about all things creative; from my latest food illustrations, design work and hand lettering doodles, to articles about freelancing and creativity.

feeds.title: Carly Watts Art & Illustration
feeds.description: Carly Watts is an illustrator inspired by decorative and folk art.

feeds.title: Carden Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Holly Carden is a freelance illustrator specializing in high detail, traditional-style illustrations for all sorts of clients, including editorial, technical, and advertising fields.

feeds.title: Chris Dunn Illustration/Fine Art
feeds.description: Chris Dunn Illustration creates unique and detailed artwork for many publications as well as for private commissions and galleries. The online home for artwork by Christopher Dunn.

feeds.title: Ann Shen Blog
feeds.description: Ann Shen is an illustrator, letterer, and author based in Los Angeles. A graduate of UCSD and Art Center College of Design, Ann has created work for a number of publications, campaigns, products, and galleries for children of all ages.

feeds.title: KidLitArtists
feeds.description: KidLitArtists.com is a group of children's illustrators who met through the SCBWI Illustration Mentorship Program.

feeds.title: Liv Wan Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Liv Wan is a freelance food and childrens illustrator based in Edinburgh, Scotland. Liv's illustration style is bold, colourful and fun, She likes to illustrate bright happy things and wishes to bring happiness to people who see her illustrations. Since she turned her career around and started work as an illustrator she has worked with several agencies.

feeds.title: Anton Emdin Illustration & Cartoons Blog
feeds.description: Illustrations from award-winning illustrator and cartoonist, Anton Emdin. Clients include GQ, The Spectator, MAD, Penthouse, Rolling Stone, Mens Health, Kelloggs, Luxbet, Saatchi & Saatchi and more.

feeds.title: Marjorie Sarnat Design & Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Marjorie Sarnat's fanciful coloring book style evolved from her love of patterns, which she developed through an earlier career as a textile designer. She is a Illustrator of best selling adult coloring books Creative Cats, Owls, and many more.Also influencing her style is her lifelong passion for collecting vintage illustrated books and ephemera.

feeds.title: Ohn Mar Win Illustration
feeds.description: Ohnmar Win is a UK based illustrator with a passion for food illustration, travel and hand lettering. After graduating with a degree in Advertising and Design a rather long time ago she pursued a editorial illustration career with a large helping of greetings cards whilst freelancing at Tigerprint.

feeds.title: Wordless News
feeds.description: Wordless News is a project by illustrator designer Maria Fabrizio. Wordless News is a weekday creative ritual starting at 4:45am. Maria gets up, reads the news, sketches, digitizes, and posts an editorial illustration for a selected headline.

feeds.title: Isabel Aracama I Illustrator & Designer Blog
feeds.description: I create posts about illustration, festivals, conferences, classes, interviews and write tutorials focused mainly on digital illustration. Improve your digital drawing skills so that you can either start a career or get better in your profession as an artist or illustrator.

feeds.title: Robert M. Ball
feeds.description: I'm Robert M. Ball. I'm an illustrator, designer and comic maker, living and working in London.

feeds.title: Fifi Lapin
feeds.description: I'm Fifi Lapin, hare-ss to my fathers forture and 'the worlds most stylish bunny'.

feeds.title: Diana Toledano Blog
feeds.description: A Spanish girl illustrating, teaching and living in San Francisco.

feeds.title: Blenda Studio Blog
feeds.description: Blenda Studio website showcases art and design created by Blenda Tyvoll. Your source for charmingly bold and beautiful artwork to brighten your heart and home. You'll read stories from the artist's point of view about why and how each art series was created.

feeds.title: Matthew Shipley Illustration Blog
feeds.description: I'm Matthew Shipley and I'm an Illustrator, Designer and Animator. I graduated with a BFA in Illustration from Brigham Young University.

feeds.title: Pure Illustration
feeds.description: Pure Illustration represent both established commercial illustrators & new talented graduate artists with exciting and original ideas. They represent artists and illustrators from around the world and present their art to our customers in the Greetings Card, Stationery, Gift product, Home ware, Advertising and Editorial markets around the world.

feeds.title: marionlindsayillustration Blog
feeds.description: My name is Marion and I am a children's book illustrator who makes pictures with ink, pencils and a computer. I often use a mishmash of techniques to create my illustrations and patterns and I really like making up characters whether they be human, animal or somewhere in between.

feeds.title: NVO
feeds.description: An illustration blog that helps me kick him into gear and just DRAW.

feeds.title: Holly Main
feeds.description: I am an illustrator and cartoonist based in Toronto, Ontario. I love humour found in the everyday and use it as inspiration for my comics and illustrations. I studied fine arts at the University of Ottawa and use pen and ink, coloured digitally, as my go-to medium.

feeds.title: Evan Turk's Travel, Reportage and Illustration Blog
feeds.description: A blog featuring the art, animation, illustration, travel, and reportage of Evan Turk.

feeds.title: Pompey Illustration
feeds.description: A blog by the University of Portsmouth, Illustration BA (HONS) Degree Course. This is our news blog showing events, exhibitions, publications, degree shows and current projects

feeds.title: Michael Hoeweler
feeds.description: Michael Hoeweler was born and raised along the outskirts of Cincinnati, Ohio. After a youth spent exploring the Midwestern landscape of cornfields and suburban expanses, he left for Baltimore, Maryland, where he graduated with a BFA in illustration from the Maryland Institute College of Art.

feeds.title: Kokblog
feeds.description: I'm Johanna Kindvall. I'm an illustrator who divides my time between Brooklyn and south Sweden. I like to draw ordinary things and things I find amusing or deeply serious. My style is simple and minimal. In 2005, I started my illustrated cooking blog kokblog. On kokblog I share my own recipes that are mostly inspired by Nordic cuisine.

feeds.title: Lindsay Gardner Art & Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Lindsay Gardner Art & Illustration is a blog and sketchbook of artist and illustrator, Lindsay Gardner. Her work is inspired by colors, shapes and patterns she finds in nature and architecture, woven and knitted textiles; eating and cooking; seasons and how they impact our customs and traditions; and family histories.

feeds.title: Michele Melcher Illustration Blog
feeds.description: I am from rural Bucks County, Pennsylvania where I spent the majority of my childhood drawing unicorns and being chased by my best friend's pet goats. I attended Bucks County Community College and graduated with an Associates Degree in Fine Art as well as my BFA in Illustration, from the University of the Arts in Philadelphia. I have been working as a freelance illustrator ever since.

feeds.title: Tim Miller Blog
feeds.description: Tim Miller is an author and illustrator of children's books. Tim Miller is a satirical Illustrator who specializes in picture books. He studied at SVA where he earned his BFA in Cartooning and is currently based in NY.

feeds.title: Emily Catherine Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Emily is a freelance Illustrator living in Nottingham. Emily specializes in hand-drawn and hand-painted illustrations and artworks. She has a wide ranging portfolio and always likes to try new and challenging projects.

feeds.title: Michelle Baron
feeds.description: A place for inspiration, sketches, and illustration by Michelle Baron. I'm an illustrator who loves monograms, hand written notes, sailor stripes, silk dresses, and all things about fashion. I'm a freelancer, working from home, and looking for inspiration in everything.

feeds.title: Sarah Goodreau
feeds.description: Sarah Goodreau is an Illustrator/Author living in London, UK. She was born in Massachusettes, USA and attended the Savannah College of Art and Design where she received a BFA in Illustration. Since then Sarah has worked for for various publications illustrating for children's books. She is also the co-creator and art director of Wizard Fingers, an animation group.

feeds.title: Fashion Illustration by Rongrong DeVoe Blog
feeds.description: Rongrong DeVoe is an international freelance fashion illustrator based in Houston, TX, US. Serving New York, London, Paris and worldwide. In this blog you will see the latest updates of her fashion illustration projects, my illustration commissions, my fashion illustration tutorials and fashion events.

feeds.title: Lee White Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Lee White is a Portland based illustrator working in the publishing industry. His clients include Simon and Schuster, Viking, Disney, and many others. He works primarily in watercolor, but likes to include all sorts of media, such as ink, colored pencil and collage.

feeds.title: Stewart Illustrations
feeds.description: Living in Calgary, Alberta, Matt Stewart is an illustrator, designer, and web developer. One of the main types of artwork he produces is sketch cards for licensed trading card companies like Topps and Upper-Deck to produce Star Wars and other types of cards. This is a blog about his artwork, news, sketch cards, and all things nerdy that interest him like comic books, sports cards, comic cons, and more.

feeds.title: SketchAround Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Dave Jernigan - an art teacher and illustrator living in Las Vegas, Nevada. I created this blog to encourage myself to draw regularly. I create my illustrations using a multitude of art media such as acrylic, oil washes, markers, and pen & ink. My focus of subject matter is primarily humorous children's illustrations, though I enjoy illustrating a variety of topics.

feeds.title: Plum Pudding Illustration
feeds.description: As one of the leading children's illustration agencies in the world, Plum Pudding is known for being one of the most dynamic, passionate and proactive agencies around, representing some of the most talented children's illustrators from across the globe.

feeds.title: Agent Pekka
feeds.description: We're an illustration agency that champions originality, creativity and craftsmanship.Agent Pekka is an illustration agency that champions originality and craftsmanship. We're based in Helsinki, Los Angeles and Amsterdam and work globally. We're dedicated to 3D, animation, iconography, illustration, infographics, installations, pattern design and typography.

feeds.title: Picture Desk
feeds.description: Picture Desk is featuring art projects and illustrators behind them. We try to explore stories of vulnerable creativity and persistence at work of contemporary artists.

feeds.title: Felicita sala illustration
feeds.description: Felicita is a self taught illustrator. She graduated in Philosophy from the University of Western Australia. She has worked on several animation projects along with husband Gianluca, but her passion is making picture books. She lives in Rome with Gianluca and their daughter Nina.

feeds.title: Emmeline Illustration
feeds.description: Illustration, inspiration, creative tips, reviews, illustrated products and creative industry discussion from award-winning illustrator Emmeline Pidgen.

feeds.title: Jolly Edition Blog
feeds.description: Illustration and Stationery Made in Baltimore. Wedding Invitations, Wedding Stationery and Illustrations Custom Made. Gifts for the Home, Family, Kitchen and Kids

feeds.title: Anna Goodson
feeds.description: Anna Goodson is the Founder of Anna Goodson Illustration Agency and MEATMARKET Photography. Anna has spent the last 28 years working with creatives and promoting their work. She's passionate and innovative and is considered a leader and trend setter in her field.

feeds.title: Chris Wahl Art
feeds.description: Chris Wahl is an Illustrator and commercial artist. His clients include Lucasfilm, Ubisoft, MAD magazine, Nitro Circus, Titan Comics and Marvel.

feeds.title: Cristina Alonso
feeds.description: Cristina Alonso is an international illustrator who works with a wide range of high profile clients and commercial brands in the fashion, beauty and luxury industries. She has illustrated many advertising campaigns, magazines, books and exclusive products all around the world. Cristina has a Bachelor's Degree in Hispanic Philology and is University Specialist in Professional Illustration.

feeds.title: Grain edit
feeds.description: Grain edit is focused on classic design work from the 1950s-1970s and contemporary designers that draw inspiration from that time period. Site content includes interviews, articles, designers' libraries as well as examples of rare design annuals, type specimens, Ephemera, posters and vintage kids books from our bookshelves.

feeds.title: Nocloo
feeds.description: A Gallery of Golden Age Children's Book Illustrations and their Illustrators.

feeds.title: Pikaland
feeds.description: Amy Ng founded Pikaland in 2008. She started this blog when she was curious about the world of illustration. Five years on, she have taken on several illustration commissions, and was also appointed a creative director for a regional agency. She teach online workshops for artists & illustrators, and create goodies to expand your creative horizons.

feeds.title: Marloes De Vries Blog
feeds.description: Marloes De Vries is an award-winning illustrator and author, working on (picture) books, magazines and comics.

feeds.title: Tiny Grey Art Illustration - Blog
feeds.description: Tiny Grey is a small art and illustration studio founded by Sophie Scott-Lewis. Tiny Grey offers a unique and quirky array of character design as well as bespoke portrait commissions of families and pets.
